title: PM Kisan eKYC: Complete This Step To Receive 22nd Installment Of Rs 2,000 | Economy News - News18
text: PM Kisan 22nd Installment E-KYC: The central government continues to support farmers’ income under the PM Kisan Samman Nidhi scheme, which provides Rs 6,000 annually in three equal installments through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). So far, 21 installments have been released, benefiting crores of farmers across the country. Prime Minister Narendra Modi disbursed the 21st installment on November 19 in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, transferring Rs 18,000 crore to over nine crore farmers. Since the scheme’s launch, more than Rs 4 lakh crore has been credited directly into beneficiaries’ bank accounts. As farmers now await the 22nd installment in 2026, completing mandatory e-KYC has become crucial. Without e-KYC verification, eligible farmers may not receive the upcoming Rs 2,000 installment. The government has repeatedly urged beneficiaries to complete Aadhaar-based e-KYC to avoid payment delays or rejections. In order to be eligible for the PM-Kisan’s 19th installment, a person needs to fulfill below mentioned conditions: To receive the installments, the farmers need to complete their e-KYC. According to the scheme’s official website, “eKYC is MANDATORY for PMKISAN Registered Farmers. OTP-based eKYC is available on the PMKISAN Portal, or the nearest CSC centres may be contacted for Biometric-based eKYC". 1) Visit the official website — https://pmkisan.gov.in/. 2) Now, click on the tab ‘Know Your Status’ on the right side of the page. 3) Enter your registration number and fill Captcha Code, and select ‘Get Data’ option. Your beneficiary status will come up on the screen. Step 1: Visit PM Kisan official website https://pmkisan.gov.in/ Step 2: Click on the ‘Beneficiary list’ tab. Step 3: Select details from the drop-down such as select state, district, sub-district, block, and village Step 4: Click on the ‘Get report’ tab After this, the beneficiary list will be displayed. You can call on the helpline numbers — 155261 and 011-24300606. Step 1: Visit https://pmkisan.gov.in/ Step 2: Click on ‘New Farmer Registration’ and enter Aadhaar number and fill the captcha Step 3: Enter the required details and click on ‘Yes’ Step 4: Fill in the information asked in the PM-Kisan application form, save it and take a printout for future reference.
